This datasheet is a FortiGate appliance (not a transceiver module). Modes below group slot types that co-occur in the hardware spec and ordering text, repeated per SKU (`FG-3600E`, `FG-3600E-DC`, `FG-3601E`). Chassis power `672 W` / `977 W` is global (same row for all models); `672` is used as average consumption per interface mode. No penalty objects were in the input. `GE RJ45` management is omitted because it has no matching `form_factor` / `media_interface_name` in the pool.
